status.offline: Offline: edits are kept in the browser and will be sent when the connection returns

refusal.auth: Sign in again: the session has ended
refusal.forbidden: You are not allowed to open this file
refusal.unsupported: Live editing is not available for this file
refusal.busy: The server is busy: too many people are editing this file
refusal.too_large: The file is too large for live editing

problem.save_failed: The server could not write the file, retrying
problem.too_large: The text grew past the live editing limit and is not being saved
problem.file_gone: The file was deleted or replaced

readOnly: Read mode: you see others' edits live but cannot write
external: Changes from git or another source were merged
externalConflicts: Changes from git overlapped yours: the other version is kept in history
reset: The server rebuilt the document: your unsaved text will come back from the draft
